text: {"lessons":["I made no trades despite large swings in account value; doing nothing avoided impulsive reactions, but I should still check that my holdings and risk remain appropriate.","The decline through Period 5 was followed by a recovery, reinforcing that short-term price movements are unpredictable and do not by themselves justify a trade.","My reluctance to realize losses and satisfaction from gains can distort decisions, so future trades should be based on risk, diversification, and investment rationale—not purchase price or recent performance."]}
